|errata_history=This is the original printing of “A Jedi's Fury” in Virtual Modern (version 1 of 3): the card image in place when Virtual Set 21 was officially released (18 June 2023). The current text is [[A Jedi's Fury (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version is the Players Committee's own card image, quoted in full with its upload date; the image on each page is that version's image as published (unchanged). The PC card data (swccg-card-json) is cited as dating evidence only.
* '''Original''' (this page): the card image at official release (18 June 2023)<ref name="ht-04fafe9">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/04fafe9a4fc2c8a87e045ba98e3a4c685106d50c 04fafe9] “Set 21 plus stuff”, 18 June 2023.</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, choose: USED: If a character of ability > 4 was just ‘hit’ during battle, opponent loses 1 Force. OR Peek at the bottom card of your Force Pile; may move it to the top of that pile. LOST: Cancel game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cj-1ad7bd9">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/1ad7bd9 swccg-card-json commit 1ad7bd9] “all of the LS V21 cards” (17 June 2023) first gave the card this wording.</ref> The card image prints no errata mark.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Jedi's Fury (Errata)]]): the errata card image (29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata)<ref name="ht-efc26cd">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/efc26cd8f4f02c4acb5707cb0d67361cc69322ba efc26cd] “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”, 29 December 2024, for the PC's Set 24 errata.</ref> prints: “USED: Peek at the bottom card of your Force Pile; may move it to the top of that pile. LOST: Steal Luke’s Lightsaber into hand (immune to Weapon Of A Sith). OR If His Destiny on table, cancel game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cj-e1137c3">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/e1137c3 swccg-card-json commit e1137c3] “More cards and fixes” (15 January 2025) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The text was rewritten. The opening “If His Destiny on table, choose:” was removed (His Destiny is now named only in the last option); the USED option “If a character of ability > 4 was just ‘hit’ during battle, opponent loses 1 Force.” was removed, leaving the Force Pile peek as the only USED text; LOST gained “Steal Luke’s Lightsaber into hand (immune to Weapon Of A Sith).” and the Dark Jedi option became “OR If His Destiny on table, cancel game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.” The image also sets USED and LOST on separate lines. The card image prints the errata mark “E1” at bottom right.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[A Jedi's Fury (Errata 2)]]): the errata card image (7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”))<ref name="ht-e02f932">Players Committee card image, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif as uploaded] to the PC's Holotable image repository (served at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual21-Light/large/ajedisfury.gif res.starwarsccg.org]) in commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/e02f932ae2c407c7c4f2e22fe565a8a64afd742b e02f932] “LS Errata”, 7 March 2026, for the PC's 2026 errata (“Tweak Set 2026”).</ref> prints: “If His Destiny on table, choose: Luke steals Luke’s Lightsaber. (Immune to Weapon Of A Sith.) OR Cancel Dark Strike, Force Field, or You Are Beaten. OR Cancel the game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn. OR Target a Jedi. Target is power +2 for remainder of turn.”<ref name="cj-4a981d6">Dating evidence only: the PC card data [https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/4a981d6 swccg-card-json commit 4a981d6] “Light - Tweak Set 2026” (15 March 2026) changed the card to this wording.</ref> '''What changed:''' The card became a Lost Interrupt (it was a Used or Lost Interrupt) and was rewritten as four choices under “If His Destiny on table, choose:”: “Luke steals Luke’s Lightsaber. (Immune to Weapon Of A Sith.)”, the new “Cancel Dark Strike, Force Field, or You Are Beaten.”, “Cancel the game text of a Dark Jedi with Luke for remainder of turn.” (“the” added) and the new “Target a Jedi. Target is power +2 for remainder of turn.” The USED Force Pile peek was removed. The card image prints the errata mark “E2” at bottom right.
